newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Basf to invest $300 mln in South America.
newsitem.headline: Basf to invest $300 mln in South America.

text.p: BASF AG said it will invest $300 million in South America over the next four years to develop and launch strategic products in the region, said Basf's Brazil unit in a statement.
Nearly 80 percent of the total investment, or $240 million, will be invested in Brazil in its existing plastic, pharmaceutical and paint plants, it said.
The remainder will be invested in BASF's petrochemical plants in Argentina and Chile it added.

The company also said it has created an executive committee for South America, made up of BASF's main executives in the region, which will be headed by Wilfried Kahlmann, president of BASF in South America.
The committee will set strategic priorities for the region, it said.
